newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portugal state railway loss deepens in 95.
newsitem.headline: Portugal state railway loss deepens in 95.

text.p: Portugal's state railway Caminhos de Ferro Portugueses (CP) posted a loss of 59.76 billion escudos ($386.9 million) in 1995, compared with a loss of 48.37 billion in 1994, a report by a department of the Finance Ministry said.
A study by the Office for the Analysis of Financing of the State and Public Companies (GAFEEP) said the increased loss was due mainly to increased wage subsidies and investment costs.
Portuguese media has reported that the Socialist government of Prime Minister Antonio Guterres will decide in November on its privatisation plans for some CP services.
